summary: Added return-concentration as 4th NSGA-III objective (f4 = max_single_trade_pnl / max(sum_positive_trade_pnl, ε)). Both engines track max_single_trade_pnl, sum_positive_trade_pnl, sum_negative_trade_pnl in metrics. f4 gate rejects rules with f4 > 0.5 at pool admission. All 276 unit tests + 9 property tests + 61 GPU engine tests pass. N_OBJ is modular — PHASE2_F4_ENABLED=False reverts to 3-objective flow exactly.
notes: GPU engine output array extended from 10→13 elements (added gross_profit, gross_loss, max_single_trade_pnl).
f4 is computed in compute_phase2_objectives_from_metrics and uses min(train_f4, val_f4) when JOINT_TRAIN_VAL=True.
f4 = 0 when executed_trades < trade_floor (no concentration signal on thin data).
f4_concentration gate is the 10th gate in _feasibility_gate_failures and _passes_pool_admission_impl.
evox_runner.py N_OBJ = 4 when PHASE2_F4_ENABLED=True, else 3. All np.full and ref-vector calls use N_OBJ.
Tested regression: PHASE2_F4_ENABLED=False returns 3 objectives, no f4 in metrics.
Did NOT modify evaluator_v5.ipynb, the time-exit return branch, rb_governor.py, or other phase files.
risks: 4-objective Pareto fronts will look different from 3-objective fronts — expected, but downstream metrics (valid_rules count, diversity) may shift. Task-3 (RB Governor) is designed to validate OOS improvement.
GPU engine result array size changed (10→13); any external code consuming gpu_engine output directly (not through _batch_metrics_from_array) needs updating.
